mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (3906, 17093) and has to end up at (-10817, 6785). On the way it must stop at A (Mesa Heliport) at (11892, 22762), B (Los Angeles Unified School District Headquarters Helipad) at (3903, 6281), C (Garland Center Heliport) at (3176, 5668), D (Harbor/UCLA Medical Center Heliport) at (682.2, -18992); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Jack Northrop Field Hawthorne Municipal Airport (KHHR, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z2 [Los Angeles International Airport (KLAX, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [Santa Monica Municipal Airport (KSMO, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [Hollywood Burbank/Bob Hope Airport (KBUR, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z5 [Long Beach International Airport (KLGB, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z6 [Van Nuys Airport (KVNY, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 91452 meters. The battery only allows 96183 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is 520 North Central Avenue Heliport; DEST is Century City Heliport.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
